'''Gear Up''' is the second main Story Mission in of Chapter 1: Just Like Paradise in [[Grand Theft Auto VI]], and the third main Story Mission overall.

== Overview ==
Jason receives a call from [[Andrew]], then heads over to see him at the [[Ammu-Nation (HD Universe)|Ammu-Nation]] gun shop to purchase a long gun.

Upon exiting, three [[The Kingfishers|Kingfishers]] pull up to the shop, and Jason fends off their attack.
